''See also: [[First Elder Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|The First Elder is a high-ranking figure within the [[Path of the White Fox]] and serves as a [[Forger]]. Physically, he is characterized by a thin, upright posture, exceptionally long eyebrows that reach toward his hair, and a wispy beard that extends to the floor. His attire consists of [[Jade|jade]] and gold robes that complement the architecture of the [[Clan Hall]], where he frequently conducts soul testing for young Wei. As a [[Forger]], his abilities involve creating intricate, detailed illusions made of light and [[dreams]]; however, these deceptions lack physical substance and are easily destroyed by attacks. The First Elder has maintained a personal interest in [[Lindon|Wei Shi Lindon]] since the latter's initial [[madra]] test, during which he determined that [[Lindon]] was unsouled and lacked spiritual affinity. He is known to consult with other high-ranking members, such as the [[Eighth Elder]], and has demonstrated a willingness to defend his path against powerful outsiders.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|The First Elder possesses very long eyebrows. Their robes are colored in [[Jade|jade]] and gold to coordinate with the tiles and pillars of the [[Clan Hall]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|As a leader within the [[Wei clan]], this individual takes a personal interest in [[Lindon]]'s progress. They are proactive in their leadership, requesting meetings to review specific events and setting expectations for when others should arrive.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|The First Elder maintains a connection to [[Lindon]], having taken a personal interest in him during his initial [[madra]] test and later providing him with the book [[Path of the White Fox]]. Additionally, the First Elder is currently visiting the [[Eighth Elder]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|This individual utilizes the [[Fox Dream]] [[technique]].}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|As a leader within the [[Wei clan]], the First Elder requested that [[Lindon]] appear to review the day's events.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c3">''Unsouled'', chapter 3</ref> [[The Elder]] wears [[Jade|jade]] and gold robes that match the tiles and pillars of the [[Clan Hall]], and possesses very long eyebrows.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c3" /> While standing on the stairs of the [[Hall of Elders]], it is noted that the First Elder resides in a house ideally suited for cultivating [[White Fox|White Fox madra]].<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c5">''Unsouled'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c6">''Unsouled'', chapter 6</ref> After giving [[Lindon]] the book [[Path of the White Fox]], the First Elder expected to see him before sunset on the day of the [[Foundation]] [[tournament]].<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c11">''Unsouled'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c12">''Unsouled'', chapter 12</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Bloodline}} ===
